source_contracts.trace: SettledGarment captures the same input selection and garment saved-drape data; validate delegates selection and drape owners. SettledDrape stores body compatibility metadata, original settled positions, material UV, cloth faces and one surface binding per saved vertex. Live input/Fit/output have different responsibilities; saved bindings are a reusable conformation description, not a second mutable simulation authority. Actual outfit78639-54 consumes saved.wear or live drape under one DrapeOutcome contract; producer outfit82158-65 puts the piece saved drape beside its selected input. source_contracts.role: SurfaceBinding named triangle, barycentric and frame-offset components
source_contracts.trace: Private named record separates native body triangle ordinal from dimensionless weights of second/third corners and metre offsets along tangent/bitangent/normal. bind queries same wearer BVH, computes barycentric weights, obtains its frame and projects point-origin into axes. place reconstructs origin+axis*distance using same ordered fields. frame gets triangle from same BVH/faces and interpolates normals, then uses explicit smooth/face/fallback normal and projected/fallback tangent. Named record preserves unlike roles; homogeneous arrays are actual local numerical basis data. Anatomical PartFrame from2178 additionally owns placement half-extents/reflection semantics and is not automatically interchangeable with this interpolated surface basis.

source_contracts.role: Meaningful wire record versus native u32/float bits
source_contracts.trace: SurfaceBinding packs6words: triangle then2barycentric f32 bit patterns then3offset f32 bit patterns. Existing Packed implementations separately encode Vec2/Vec3 float arrays through to_bits and triangle arrays through native u32 words. Serde adapter serializes these as one STANDARD base64 string over little-endian u32 bytes, preserving channel/record type through each generic field adapter. Shared u32 storage does not mean triangle identity and numerical float bits are one domain type; adding application wrappers around wire words would duplicate the actual boundary.

source_contracts.role: Exact packing arity admission and separate value validation
source_contracts.trace: deserialize reads string, base64 decodes, requires byte length modulo (T::WORDS*size_of u32)==0, decodes little-endian four-byte chunks, then calls T::unpack only on chunks_exact(T::WORDS). Reached WORDS are2/3/6, so SurfaceBinding receives exactly6words before its direct word indices. This establishes concrete record-shape receiver, not semantic validity. SettledDrape.validate separately requires nonempty cloth, one position/UV/binding per vertex, bounded cloth faces, bounded body triangle and finite floats. Derive deserialization does not itself establish the explicit validation was called by every downstream caller; full recipe/inventory admission is not newly cleared.

source_contracts.role: Captured bindings and same-topology numerical receiver
source_contracts.trace: capture requires settled stage, matches UV/position length, builds all bindings from actual garment positions against input wearer geometry, copies corresponding saved arrays and calls drape.validate. fit builds current Wearer after count check, reconstructs bound vertices, uses SewnCloth from original saved topology to limit stretch, clears combined body/inner garments and optional UnderPlate, restores saved UV/faces, computes current normals/typed rig transfer and contact warnings. Previous781/785/786 and new787 exact consumers support this same local flow. No arbitrary deserialized record or public mutation equivalence claim.
